mechanism: Estradiol increases hepatic binding globulin production, which increases hydrocortisone protein binding and may reduce free cortisol levels; hydrocortisone may increase estradiol metabolism via CYP3A4 induction at higher doses.
action: Monitor clinical response to hydrocortisone therapy; adjust dose if needed based on cortisol levels and clinical effect; counsel on potential for reduced contraceptive efficacy with high-dose hydrocortisone.
